items.html: *Let us also complete the explanation of the matter of the principal cause, what it was. It is that His intention was to create this world, in which there is reward and punishment, and this is impossible save through a Kostiner [an executioner], which is the measure of evil, to exact payment from the wicked. And behold, this evil is the root of the dross and the lees of the Gevurot and the judgments, in the secret of “the place of judgment, there is wickedness.” And understand this.
